description: The reviewers' specification of classifyPayment (P01.T04a §5 rules 1-9; ADR-0015 R3 and R7-R10), written independently of packages/policy/src/billing-state.ts. The first rule whose every listed dimension matches a row decides it; a dimension a rule does not list matches every value. scripts/billing-decision-tables.mjs generates classify-payment.tsv from these rules, and tests/billing-decision-tables.test.mjs builds a target, event and terms table from every row and checks that the library returns the row's outcome, or throws BILLING_INPUT_INVALID or BILLING_FACTS_INVALID for input_invalid. Replay (already_granted), tenant mismatch and terms mismatch are precedence rules tested separately; every row uses a matching terms entry and an unseen payment key.

dimensions.name: phase
dimensions.meaning: The workspace's route phase (§3). Ignored for an unattributed target, which has no workspace.

dimensions.name: provider
dimensions.meaning: The event's payment route: Stripe (morrow_direct) or App Pricing (shopify_app_pricing).

dimensions.name: mode
dimensions.meaning: Whether the event's mode is the environment's (R9).

dimensions.name: relation
dimensions.meaning: The event's subscription against the payer's recorded subscription (its entitlement), which this dimension alone describes: none (no payer, or a payer with no subscription recorded yet), current (the recorded one, active), other_live (another while the recorded one is active), new_after_terminal (another after the recorded one became terminal) or current_terminal (the recorded one itself, cancelled). A top-up names no subscription, so it is none, current or current_terminal by the payer's recorded subscription.

dimensions.name: payer
dimensions.meaning: The event's payer (Stripe: the workspace's storeless account; App Pricing: the installation's account) by its account and reversal facts only, independent of its recorded subscription, which relation alone gives: none (no account), active (an active account with no open reversal), suspended (a suspended account) or reversed (an active account with an open reversal of a payment it was granted). The payer is billable only when it is active and relation names its live recorded subscription; only top-ups read it.

dimensions.name: attribution
dimensions.meaning: Stripe: a mapped customer (attributed) or not (unattributed). App Pricing: an installation with a current link, associated but not currently linked, or not associated with any workspace (unattributed).

dimensions.name: amount
dimensions.meaning: Whether amountPaid is above zero, that is, money was collected (R3).

rules.source: An App Pricing event is never a top-up (§4.1; App Pricing has no one-time purchases).
A Stripe event names no installation (§4.1).
An unattributed target carries no workspace and no payer (§5 PaymentTarget).
An unattributed target carries no recorded subscription (§5 PaymentTarget).
A recorded subscription (an entitlement) needs its account.
No installation was ever associated with an open workspace (§3).
Accounts exist only once a route is fixed (§8.3).
A morrow_direct workspace has exactly one storeless account, created when its route was fixed (R5, §8.3).
A morrow_direct workspace has no per-installation account (R5).
A Shopify-route workspace has no storeless account (R5).
A top-up names no subscription (§4.1).
Rule 1 (R9): an event in the other mode neither fixes, entitles nor grants.
Rule 3 (R8): held with the target's reason; never dropped or refunded automatically.
Rule 3 (R8): a plan chosen on Shopify's plan page before any link; re-classified in the link transaction.
Rule 4 (R3): no money collected fixes no route and grants nothing.
Rule 5 (R7): a Stripe payment for a Shopify-bound or Shopify-route workspace.
Rule 5 (R7): an App Pricing payment on an installation of a morrow_direct workspace.
Rule 7 (R10): a top-up is granted on morrow_direct while the payer is billable: an active account with no open reversal whose current subscription is active.
Rule 7 (R7): a top-up without a billable subscription.
Rule 8: the planChanges entry's credits for the payer's current subscription.
Rule 8 (R7): a different subscription while the current one is live.
Rule 8 (R7): a plan change on a terminal subscription.
Rule 8 (R8): no payer or subscription matches yet; re-classified when that subscription's period is accepted or the entitlement fold records it.
Rule 9 (R3): the first completed Stripe period fixes morrow_direct only in phase open.
Rule 9 (R3): the first completed App Pricing period of an associated installation fixes shopify_app_pricing only in phase shopify_bound.
Rule 9 (R5): an installation's first period creates its account, current link or not.
Rule 9: a period of the payer's current subscription.
Rule 9 (R7): a second subscription while the current one is not terminal.
Rule 9 (R7): a late payment on a terminal subscription.

Rule 9 (R7, R8), recorded refinement: a payer whose subscription is not recorded yet, or a new subscription after a terminal one, is held until the entitlement fold records it. The fold re-classifies the payer's held periods, so the recorded subscription is granted and any other is DUPLICATE_SUBSCRIPTION; two resubscriptions are never both granted.
